acceptance_criteria: Use only the buyer-authorized staging origin and at most five agreed GET paths. Do not include credentials or private response bodies in the report.
Evaluate and record each of at most ten agreed finite assertions, including failures. A buyer API defect is a report finding, not automatically provider fault.
Include path identifiers, method, observed status, required-field checks, timings, tool version, UTC test time and the agreed input SHA-256 fingerprint.
Provide a JSON report and short Markdown explanation, each no more than 64 KiB, as one private JSON delivery bundle or supported private attachments.
Deliver within the agreed deadline of no more than 24 hours. The buyer reviews and explicitly accepts the original delivered content hash.
Platform task checks validate required keys only; they do not observe remote test execution, fetch the API, certify semantic accuracy or establish independence.
